entries.title: Honey Butter Toast
entries.kw: honey butter toast appetizers breakfast dessert 1 loaf of challah bread 8 tablespoons softened butter 3 tablespoons @taylorpasshoneyusa 4 tablespoons light brown sugar 1 splash of vanilla extract to serve: 1 vanilla ice cream 1 salted carmel or more honey recipe / instructions / method: step 1: cut the challah bread into thick slices- i got 6 slices out of one loaf. then trim off the excess ., no need to waste this, you can turn it into french toast or bread pudding step 2: mix the butter, brown sugar and honey together to make a smooth compound, then slather it on all sides of the sliced challah bread. step 3: arrange the slices on a parchment lined baking sheet, then bake at 360 f for about 8-10 minutes. flip, then bake for another 8-10 minutes. let the color be your guide. you want a nice deep brown, but not burnt. step 4: remove from the oven and place the slices on a cooling rack for about 15 minutes. the coating will harden as it sits. serve with ice cream and warm salted caramel or an extra drizzle of honey. 🍯 1 #honeybutter #honeybuttertoast #manuka #manukahoney #paidpartnership image url: https://media.cookbook.company/0/fe appetizers breakfast dessert
